topic: QC status: upstream QC already applied - should we re-filter or proceed with clustering?
context: Human skeletal muscle scRNA-seq dataset (324,434 cells, 55,211 genes). QC already applied upstream: 0 cells with n_genes<200, pct_mt max=5.0%, 0 predicted doublets. Data has counts layer (raw) and lognorm layer. 11 cell types identified (TypeII 43.9%, TypeI 32.0%, FAP 8.8%, etc.). Aged cells show slightly higher n_genes (median 1256 vs 1005) and total_counts (2614 vs 2330).
